ops.quote: we propose novel tensor representations for compactly capturing such higher-order relationships
SCK builds on the spatio-temporal correlations between features
DCK explicitly models the action dynamics of a sequence
SCK(+) operates on subsequences to capture the local-global interplay of correlations
can incorporate multi-modal inputs e.g., skeleton 3D body-joints and per-frame classifier scores
we introduce linearization of these kernels that lead to compact and fast descriptors
we use higher-order tensors and so-called Eigenvalue Power Normalization (EPN)
Eigenvalue Power Normalization (EPN) which have been long speculated to perform spectral detection
detects if at least one higher-order occurrence is `projected' into one of its binom(Z*,r) subspaces
forming a Tensor Power Normal, metric endowed with binom(Z*,r) such `detectors'
